content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00233 The RTE Generator in Generation Phase shall provide the BswModuleDependency in the BswModuleDescription with the role bswModuleDependency for each call- back API provided by the RTE and called by the respective Basic Software Module. The reference from the BswModuleDependency to the BswModuleEntry shall be in the role implementedEntry . The calling Basic Software Module is specified in the attribute targetModuleId of the BswModuleDependency .

The reference from the BswModuleDependency to the BswModuleEntry shall be in the role calledEntry .
